answer: Place is proof: each identity publishes an hourly signed location cipher, a GPS fix plus tower IDs. Fixes cluster by place and time; two identities sharing a 50-metre cell for 24 hours freeze until one proves a separate device. Real fixes sway like a willow and never repeat; fakes replay identical coordinates, and one tower echo cannot invent a second place. 500 fakes need 500 dispersed devices, so the farm costs more than it earns.
